title: Dutch Bros® Is Giving Drinks a Glow-Up with its Latest Merch Drop
summary: Get ready to glow! Starting at 6 p.m. on Tuesday, Sept. 22, get a free light-up cube with any medium or large drink at Dutch Bros, while supplies last.
body_markdown:
## Dutch Bros® Is Giving Drinks a Glow-Up with its Latest Merch Drop


Dutch Bros® fans, get ready to glow. The newest merch drop turns your fave drink into the main character after dark. One sip, one glow — your go-to order just became a party.


**Starting at 6 p.m. on Tuesday, September 22, every medium or large drink purchase comes with one light-up cube at participating Dutch Bros locations, while supplies last!*** Pick up your special light up cube with one of the fall faves below:


[Cookie Butter Iced Latte](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/cookie-butter/cookie-butter-iced-latte/) **🧡** A cozy, crave-worthy classic featuring espresso, milk, cookie butter flavor, cookie butter drizzle on the cup, finished with Soft Top® and cookie butter drizzle on top for the perfect sweet sip.


[Caramel Pumpkin Brûlée Iced Breve](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/caramel-pumpkin-br-l-e/caramel-pumpkin-br-l-e-iced-breve/) 🎃 Fall in a cup! This seasonal staple brings together espresso, pumpkin, salted caramel breve with Soft Top®, pumpkin drizzle and raw sugar sprinks.


[Autumn Berry Blended Rebel](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/autumn-berry/autumn-berry-blended-rebel/) **🍂** A bright, energizing Dutch Bros Rebel ® energy drink made for fall, with pomegranate, orange and peach blended to perfection and topped with mixed berry fruit for a refreshing pick-me-up!


**Light up cubes are available while supplies last. Max 5 per customer. Order ahead does not reserve items or guarantee availability.*


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
